title: Which Modality Decides? Counterfactual Modality Attribution for Multimodal Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2608.00076v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal classifiers can achieve high accuracy while exploiting modality-specific shortcuts. Modality attribution quantifies the contributions of image and text, but does not by itself identify which input changes would alter a suspicious prediction. We introduce Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA), which connects modality-level contributions to explicit prediction-changing edits. CMA uses image and text diffusion priors to generate counterfactual references and constructs a two-player reference game whose Shapley--Taylor decomposition separates image, text, and interaction contributions. The method requires class-score queries but no model gradients. Attribution profiles are compared with a reference population to prioritize predictions with atypical modality reliance for review, while counterfactual edits expose localized evidence for inspection. translated_title: 哪种模态起了决定作用？面向多模态分类器的反事实模态归因
translated_abstract: 多模态分类器即使在利用模态特定捷径的情况下也能达到很高的准确率。模态归因可以量化图像和文本的贡献，但仅凭其本身无法识别哪些输入变化会改变一个可疑的预测。我们提出了反事实模态归因（Counterfactual Modality Attribution, CMA），该方法将模态层面的贡献与显式的、能够改变预测的编辑联系起来。CMA 利用图像和文本扩散先验来生成反事实参照，并构建了一个双人参照博弈，其 Shapley–Taylor 分解可将图像、文本及交互的贡献分离开来。该方法只需要类别得分查询，而无需模型梯度。通过将归因画像与参照人群进行对比，可以优先筛选出具有非典型模态依赖的预测供人工审查，同时反事实编辑能够揭示局部化的证据以供检查。在受控的图像偏置和文本偏置分类器上，CMA 能够识别出……
tldr: 该论文提出反事实模态归因方法CMA，利用图像与文本扩散先验生成反事实参照，并通过双人参照博弈的Shapley–Taylor分解将模态贡献与可改变预测的具体编辑相关联，从而检测多模态分类器中可疑的模态依赖且无需模型梯度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Counterfactual Modality Attribution (CMA), which uses image and text diffusion priors to generate counterfactual references and a two-player reference game with Shapley–Taylor decomposition to link modality-level contributions to explicit prediction-changing edits, enabling gradient-free detection of suspicious modality reliance in multimodal classifiers.
